comment: Shared Adam lr and budget give Δ=0.06144. K1017 and K1068 favor d_model=128 over 64 in this regime, placing C/A/B ahead of E/D. At equal width and depth, K1017’s larger-feedforward tie-break selects C over A. B’s smaller feedforward dimension supports placing it behind both, although the depth difference alone is inconclusive at this Δ. E over D is supported by its larger feedforward dimension and K1069’s fewer-head tie-break; depth alone is again inconclusive. No new general rule is needed.
